**Calculation:**

- FY2023: R&D of $29,915M [DOC-1] ÷ revenue of $383,285M [DOC-1] = **7.80%**
- FY2024: R&D of $31,370M [DOC-1] ÷ revenue of $391,035M [DOC-1] = **8.02%**

R&D grew ~4.9% year over year ($29,915M → $31,370M) while revenue grew only ~2.0% ($383,285M → $391,035M) [DOC-1], so the R&D intensity ratio rose.

**Change:** 8.02% − 7.80% = an increase of approximately **0.22 percentage points** (0.217 pp).

ANSWER: Increased, by approximately 0.22 percentage points (from ~7.80% in FY2023 to ~8.02% in FY2024)
